recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片（May-Grünwald-Giemsa）中兩個淋巴樣細胞，上方細胞核圓、染色質均勻，細胞質中等量淡灰藍色，周緣有細小毛狀突起、無顆粒；這種細胞質邊緣毛糙的淋巴球即毛細胞（hairy cell），支持毛細胞白血病，但影像解析度有限。
features: Two mononuclear lymphoid cells in a red cell background (image captured through the eyepiece; resolution limited)
Upper cell: medium-sized, round nucleus with homogeneous chromatin, no obvious nucleolus
Moderate rim of pale gray-blue, agranular cytoplasm with fine, circumferential hair-like projections
Lower cell: smaller with scant cytoplasm and slightly ragged border, more condensed chromatin
Red cells show rouleaux-like overlapping in thicker areas; no granulocytes in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows two atypical lymphoid cells in a red cell background. The larger cell has a round nucleus with homogeneous chromatin finer than that of a mature lymphocyte, no obvious nucleolus, and a moderate rim of pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections; the second cell is smaller with scant cytoplasm and a slightly irregular border. Image resolution limits assessment of fine cytoplasmic detail. The findings are suggestive of circulating hairy cells; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: SMZL villous lymphocytes show short villi concentrated at one or both poles and are CD103-negative, whereas hairy cells have circumferential projections and are CD103+/CD25+.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-variant cells have a conspicuous central nucleolus and lack CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
Artifactual frayed borders occur in thick or slowly dried areas and affect all cells, while true hairy projections are fine, regular and seen in well-spread monolayer areas.
Reactive lymphocytes have deeply basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells rather than pale cytoplasm with fine hair-like projections.
